claims.citation: New York Herald, 21 September 1866, p. 3, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Java, Captain Moodie, which
left Liverpool at half-past nine o'clock on the morning
of the 8th and Queenstown on the evening of the 9th
September, arrived at this port last night.

claims.verbatim:
LIVERPOOL, Saturday—Noon.—The steam-
ship Java sailed to-day for New York with
two hundred and ninety thousand pounds in
gold.
